claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the product's pleasant scent, describing it as lovely, feminine, and wonderful.
Many customers say the product absorbs quickly and is not greasy, leaving skin soft.
Several reviewers report it works well for sensitive skin, eczema, and other skin concerns.
Some customers complain they received only one item when a set of two was ordered, and one reports no response from the company.
A few reviewers suspect the product is fake or a knockoff, citing a different smell and packaging.
